//: Shared base for every workspace (M0-T0). docs/06-开发任务拆解.md §0.1 requires
`strict` + `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`; the rest of the flags are the guards that
keep the six hard invariants of HANDOFF §4.1 checkable by the compiler.
Workspaces extend this file and may only REMOVE capability (e.g. packages/core
extends tsconfig.core.json, which drops the DOM lib) — never add, never loosen.
noEmit is TRUE here so that `pnpm typecheck` (tsc -b) never writes to the tree:
a checker that litters is a checker people stop trusting. `tsc -b --noCheck`,
which the root build step overwrites, produces the per-package dist/ output.
The emit flags below therefore apply to that build pass only.
